themes.title: General – Pharmaceuticals / Affordable Generic Retail & Ayurvedic Healthcare

hero.oneLiner: Zota Health Care positions itself as India's largest private-sector generic-pharmacy platform (Davaindia) built on a backward/forward-integrated, distributor-free model that passes 30-90% savings to consumers, alongside a legacy domestic-marketing business and an SEZ-based export franchise spanning 30+ countries.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Three business verticals - Davaindia retail generic pharmacy (73% of Q1FY27 revenue), Domestic Marketing (15%) and Export Operations (6%) - plus Everyday Herbal Group (6%), an OTC backward-integration bet.
- Davaindia calls itself India's largest private-sector generic pharmacy chain, selling only private-label medicinal, OTC, ayurvedic, cosmetic and nutraceutical products.
- Cost edge comes from eliminating the traditional pharma chain (manufacturer -> marketing company -> distributor -> retailer) and selling direct from manufacturer to consumer, cutting average consumer price from ~Rs 100 to ~Rs 25 (~75% savings) versus traditional branded pharma.
- 87.78% stake in Everyday Herbal Group (Khadi-licensed) is framed as backward integration strengthening the OTC supply chain and product development.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Rs 350 Cr QIP raised in 2026 is the primary recent capital-raise event disclosed.
- Group structure channels COCO sales through step-down subsidiary Davaindia Health Mart Limited and FOFO sales through the listed entity, with inter-company product supply priced at arm's length (ALP).
- Growth investments are being routed through dedicated subsidiaries (KMHP Ventures Limited, Curexis Ventures Private Limited) rather than directly off the listed entity's balance sheet.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Brand ambassadors] Suniel Shetty and M.S. Dhoni are Davaindia's brand ambassadors; Akshay Kumar has been appointed brand ambassador for Zota Health Care and the UGO Generic platform.
- [Management] Family-promoter led (Chairman Ketankumar Zota, MD Moxesh Zota, WTDs Kamlesh/Himanshu/Viren Zota) with a professional Group CEO hire, Sujit Paul, who previously held roles at Reliance Retail, Apollo Pharmacy and StayHappi.
- [Corporate history] Incorporated in 2000; listed on NSE-SME in 2017 and migrated to the NSE Main Board; Davaindia launched in 2017 with 3 pilot stores and reached 2,825 stores by June 2026.
- [Customer loyalty] Davaindia reports 80% repeat customers, 12% new customers and 8% lost customers.
